_comment: Credentials for the Sauce Labs My Demo App reference app. These are the app's own PUBLISHED demo accounts, documented by the vendor for automation practice - they are not real credentials and grant access to nothing. Any account that is real belongs in .env, which is git-ignored, and is read through a ${VAR} in environment_config.json.

standard_user.description: The default account. Completes the full login, catalog, cart and checkout flow.

locked_user.description: Locked account. Login is expected to fail; used for the negative path.

checkout.description: Shipping address used by the checkout phase of Reference Flow 1.

payment.description: The vendor's documented demo card for the reference app. Not a real instrument.
